Code Sample
===========

A code block via explicit directive:

.. code-block:: python

   def add(a, b):
       return a + b

A literal block introduced by a double-colon paragraph::

   x = 1
   y = x + 1

An interactive doctest session::

   >>> print("hi")
   hi

A note admonition:

.. note::

   Remember to close the file.

An index directive:

.. index:: pair: function; add
